risks: The NEX-104 pair vocabulary is still finite. A credential compounded from two words on neither list (vault_pass, seed_phrase) still passes as safe. This is the same residual direction as NEX-034 -- additive vocabulary, not a structural hole -- and it fails loudly the moment a test names the missing word.

Shell heredocs remain unreliable on this host for multi-paragraph prose. This run hit the documented failure mode a fifth time: `cat >> docs/NEXUS/BACKLOG.md <<'MARKER'` self-interleaved and produced invalid UTF-8, and ruff then refused to read the file. The file was restored with `git checkout --` and re-edited with file_editor. Never route prose destined for a file through a heredoc on this host; write with file_editor and commit with `git commit -F`.

The restoration above also discarded the uncommitted NEX-034/NEX-038 promotions that had been made earlier in the run. They were re-applied and read back, but the incident is the lesson: an uncommitted docs edit is not durable, and restoring a corrupted file is a whole-file operation that takes every uncommitted edit in it.

The NEX-104 product commit's CI has not been read at the time this checkpoint was written. NEX-104 is therefore labelled PUSHED, not VERIFIED. Promoting it without reading the verdicts would be the exact falsification the status legend exists to prevent.

decisions_this_run: Chose to harden the position of a pair test rather than extend the pair vocabulary. The pre-fix hole was not 'a missing word' but 'the words were only checked at one offset', so widening the list would have left private_key_pem-style keys leaking while appearing fixed. Scanning every adjacent pair closes a structural hole; adding spellings would only close today's examples.

Added negative controls (secretary, keyboard, key_note, api_version, private_note, access_level, signing_status) alongside the positive cases, because the fix widens a matcher and a widening without a restraint is how redaction starts eating telemetry. The 7 negatives stay green under the reverted fix, which is correct and is why their passing is not the evidence for the positives.

Declined to promote NEX-104 to VERIFIED in this run. The local gates are green and the negative control is measured, but the CI verdict for the product commit has not been read. TESTED + COMMITTED + PUSHED is the honest label; VERIFIED waits for evidence that exists rather than evidence that is expected.

Recorded the heredoc incident in full rather than quietly restoring the file. The corruption and the loss of the earlier uncommitted docs edits are both consequences of the same known trap, and a recovery note that omits them would teach the next run the wrong lesson.
